text:
incident-bot: ALERT: High error rate detected on inference.prod.redwood.com — pages sent to @alex (oncall) and @jen (sre). Current status: degraded, automatic failover active.

alex (oncall): I'm on it. Seeing widespread 5xx spikes from us-east-1, looks like a scaler/attach flake. Tagging billing early in case credits are necessary @samir.

jen (sre): I'm tracing — autoscaler attempted to detach a bad node group which left some shards unserved. Mitigation: cordon bad pool + shift traffic to warm pool. Rolling out fix now, ETA ~7-10m.

maria (support): FYI support queue: 3 tickets reporting 503s, one is Dedicated customer acct_112. I'll consolidate messages and post examples.

samir (billing): Thanks. I'll start an eligibility checklist. Need impacted account list, per-account downtime windows, and whether they have a Dedicated contract/SLA.

alex (oncall): Rough impact window is around 2025-03-10 09:45 UTC -> 10:15 UTC but there were retries afterwards. Jen — can you produce an account-level error map?

jen (sre): Running quick query to map errors by account. Pasting SQL I ran:

```
SELECT account_id, MIN(ts) AS first_err, MAX(ts) AS last_err, COUNT(*) AS errors
FROM request_logs
WHERE service = 'inference.prod' AND status >= 500
  AND ts BETWEEN '2025-03-10T09:45:00Z' AND '2025-03-10T10:15:00Z'
GROUP BY account_id
ORDER BY errors DESC;
```

jen (sre): Output (trimmed): acct_112 — sustained errors spanning ~12m, acct_305 — bursts, acct_409 — intermittent. Attached CSV: impacted_accounts_1752001234.csv (account_id, first_err, last_err, downtime_seconds).

alex (oncall): Great. We also need served-token counts during the window to reconcile billing tokens vs unserved requests.

samir (billing): Correct — token meters to avoid double-crediting. Also need confirmation of SLA terms: threshold for monthly availability and credit formula. For Dedicated customers we apply monthly prorated credit for availability loss > 5%. Send me CSV + SLA flags and I’ll calc.

lia (cs): Drafting customer-facing language. Suggest two short templates: Dedicated (explicit credit eligibility) and Hosted (pro-rated goodwill if applicable). Status page blurb draft:

```
Status: Degraded — Partial service interruptions impacting text-generation in us-east-1. Symptoms: elevated error rates and increased latency. Mitigation: traffic shifted to warm pool; engineers applied a patch to autoscaler. Next update in 15 minutes.
```

maria (support): Lia, I'll coordinate targeted outreach for the open tickets. Also preparing a standard FAQ reply for hosted customers.

samir (billing): For the credit calc I need: (1) impacted account list, (2) downtime_seconds per account, (3) whether account is on Dedicated (SLA signed) and monthly uptime baseline, (4) billing contact email. Can someone export token meter and attach?

jen (sre): Exporting token-meter and kernel attach logs now. Noting an autoscaler goroutine that stalled during node fencing — will include stack traces in RCA.

alex (oncall): Mitigation confirmed — traffic stable and error rate down to baseline. Handing this to post-incident: Jen owns RCA + postmortem, Samir owns credit eligibility calc, Maria + Lia own customer comms. I'll do on-call handoff in 10m.

lia (cs): I'll prioritize acct_112 and acct_305 for outreach — both are high-touch and should get phone/email. Draft customer email for review:

```
Hi <Customer Name>,

We experienced partial service interruptions on 2025-03-10 between 09:45 UTC and 10:15 UTC affecting requests to inference.prod in us-east-1. Our engineering team mitigated the issue and is investigating the root cause.

If your account experienced significant unserved requests during this period and you have an SLA, you may be eligible for a service credit. Our billing team will follow up with eligibility and next steps.

We apologize for the disruption and will share a full post-incident report within 72 hours.

— Redwood Inference
```

samir (billing): Quick note: For manual credits we need an approvals chain — ops lead + finance. I will assemble a spreadsheet of proposed credits and estimated cost.

maria (support): Also recommend we send a short status page update now and a follow-up when postmortem is ready. Lia — want to review the hosted template before we send.

jen (sre): Attached: impacted_accounts_1752001234.csv, token_meter_1752001234.csv, autoscaler-stack.log. Preliminary root cause: race in node detach + insufficient healthchecks on the shard controller. RCA will expand.

alex (oncall): Oncall handoff: I'm wrapping up. Handoff notes: mitigation complete, artifacts uploaded to /incidents/1752001234/, owners: jen (RCA), samir (billing credits), maria/lia (customer comms). If any high-value customer escalates, page me.

incident-bot: Incident marked RESOLVED by alex (oncall) at 1752003034. Reminder: assign postmortem and submit within 72h.

samir (billing): I'll run the credit calc once CSV has SLA flags. Expect first pass in ~4 business hours.

lia (cs): Will coordinate outreach and paste sent notes back here for records.

maria (support): Closing loop on tickets: I've updated all three customers with a short note and set follow-ups.

jen (sre): I'll schedule a quick rollback of the autoscaler change to avoid recurrence and include mitigation checklist in the postmortem.

alex (oncall): Thanks everyone. Leaving thread open for billing/customer comms updates. :thumbsup:
